symptom: A user role's Documentation/Description in Project Security is not exposed: user_roles() in Starlark has no description (module roles do), and the catalog has no user roles table with it; DESCRIBE USER ROLE was reported to leave it out.
cause: The backend already read UserRole.Description, but UserRoleInfo dropped it and userRoleToStarlark had no field for it; the catalog only had role_mappings, one row per user-role/module-role pair, with nowhere to put a per-role property. DESCRIBE/CREATE had been fixed separately (ako/mxcli#707) after the reporter's v0.26.0.
insight: Check each named surface on current main before fixing a multi-surface report: one of the three (DESCRIBE) was already fixed, and re-fixing it would have been churn. A field the backend already decodes but a lint struct omits surfaces as 'rule needs a newer mxcli (struct has no .description attribute)', which reads like a version problem rather than an omission. Two parallel catalog changes need distinct schema numbers (26 vs 27), or a cache built by one never rebuilds for the other.
